_comment: Records which key may sign a release; it holds no key. A card-backed private key is never
exportable, so it can never be a build secret: ciSigning stays false and every CI build is
unsigned. state 'Recorded' means a certificate has been issued and is present on the signing
client; every value below was read from that certificate, none of it invented. The signer name
is stored as a unicode escape so that no tool can corrupt it through a console code page.
This is the only key this project signs with: the signing scripts refuse a self-signed key, a
key without the code-signing purpose, an expired key and any key other than this one.
provider: Certum SimplySign Desktop, Open Source Code Signing in the Cloud certificate
certificateIssuer: CN=Certum Code Signing 2021 CA, O=Asseco Data Systems S.A., C=PL

notes.hashes: a signature appends to the file, so every published SHA-256 is taken after signing
notes.licence: signing adds no restriction: GPL-3.0-only, and a rebuilt binary is unsigned
notes.renewal: the certificate expires on certificateNotAfter; record the renewed values here, and keep the timestamp on everything already signed - the timestamp is what keeps old releases verifiable
